# Subway Seat for Vivaldi

Toolbars and panels on the flavor's base, the window frame one step deeper, and burnt orange for the active tab and focus. Vivaldi works out readable text on the accent by itself.

[Vivaldi](https://vivaldi.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/vivaldi/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Vivaldi › Settings › Themes › Library:

```text
Import Theme › subway-seat.zip
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Vivaldi › Settings › Themes › Library:

```text
Import Theme › subway-seat-tunnel.zip
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Vivaldi › Settings › Themes › Library:

```text
Import Theme › subway-seat-enamel.zip
```

## Follow light and dark

In Vivaldi › Settings › Themes › Theme Schedule:

```text
Follow the operating system's schedule, with Subway Seat Enamel for light
and Subway Seat (or Subway Seat Tunnel) for dark
```
